newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Westfield buys two Coles shop centres.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Westfield buys two Coles shop centres.

text.p: Property group Westfield Trust said it purchased the Chermside shopping centre in Brisbane and the Innaloo shopping centre in Perth from Coles Myer Ltd for A$185 million.
The acquisitions take the trust's shopping centre portfolio to 28 and increase its total assets to A$3.8 billion, Westfield said.
Given the low interest rate environment the purchases will be funded by borrowings and are forecast to have a positive impact on income distributions, it said.
The 39,000 sq metre Chermside centre was purchased for A$135 million and includes adjacent land and expansion potential valued at A$15 million.
The acquisition yield on the existing centre is 7.5 percent.
Westfield said it expects the expansion to cost about A$150 million.
It said it purchased the 26,000 sq metre Innaloo shopping centre for A$50 million at a yield of ll.5 percent.
